digest.component_or_area: retrigger gate / code review verdict re-check
propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision finding states unconditionally, treating code veto and plan-review attestation absence as equivalent blockers
bugfix-size-attestation findings can be cleared by earning the attestation via plan-review on the ticket without any code change, rendering the retry refusal incorrect for this criterion
the label copy condition (NO_CODE_CHANGE, TRIVIAL_REBASE) prevents re-review after attestation is earned, forcing unnecessary code edits
recheck-review must accept when the sole blocking finding is bugfix-size-attestation and the ticket carries a valid plan-review attestation, verified via the gate's own classifier
parse failures (missing header, wrong criterion id, unresolvable ticket id, non-accepted verdict) must still refuse, with verdict named in the refusal reply
